name: Filtered or Drip Coffee
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: large tablespoonful of finely ground coffee for each person
ingredients.originalText: One large tablespoonful of finely ground coffee for each person

ingredients.name: boiling water for every tablespoonful of coffee
ingredients.originalText: One cupful of boiling water for every tablespoonful of coffee

ingredients.name: part Mocha to two of Java coffee
ingredients.originalText: One part Mocha to two of Java coffee

instructions.text: Have a small iron ring made to fit the top of the coffeepot inside
Sew a small muslin bag to this ring
Fit the bag into the pot and pour some boiling water in it
When the pot is well warmed, put the ground coffee into the bag
Pour over as much boiling water as is required
When all the water has filtered through, remove the bag
The water should be poured on the coffee gradually so that the infusion may be stronger

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Have a small iron ring made to fit the top of the coffeepot inside
2. Sew a small muslin bag to this ring
3. Fit the bag into the pot and pour some boiling water in it
4. When the pot is well warmed, put the ground coffee into the bag
5. Pour over as much boiling water as is required
6. Close the lid
7. When all the water has filtered through, remove the bag
8. Send the coffee to table
9. The water should be poured on the coffee gradually so that the infusion may be stronger
originalIngredients: One large tablespoonful of finely ground coffee for each person
One cupful of boiling water for every tablespoonful of coffee
One part Mocha to two of Java coffee
